note: Discovery leads are not verified releases. Source coverage and per-run failures are recorded separately; none of these lists is exhaustive.

sources.name: Models.dev
sources.role: Canonical model IDs, current inventory and Git history for historical backfill.
sources.note: The GitHub fallback enumerates canonical model TOMLs; it does not import unverified metadata. Catalog dates require primary-source verification.

sources.name: OpenRouter
sources.role: Independent hosted-model inventory, including smaller developers.
sources.note: created is a provider listing timestamp, not the model release date. Delisted and never-hosted models are absent.

sources.name: Hugging Face
sources.role: Global new and updated repositories, without an author or popularity whitelist.
sources.note: Enumerates each task in createdAt and lastModified order. Missing or incorrect task tags, private/deleted repositories, and historical repositories updated after the target month remain coverage gaps. Repository timestamps do not prove public availability.

sources.name: ModelScope
sources.role: Global recent repository changes, including releases absent from Hugging Face.
sources.note: The public API supports last_modified ordering and at most 3,000 results. Live probes ignored task filters, so task classification is local and untagged rows remain candidates. Older windows need owner/search partitions or manual review.

sources.name: Artificial Analysis
sources.note: Optional API requires ARTIFICIAL_ANALYSIS_API_KEY. The benchmark API is selective and never treated as a complete release census. Credit Artificial Analysis when publishing its benchmark data.

sources.name: Arena
sources.role: Independent benchmark names and preview leads.
sources.note: Manual sentinel: no stable documented public inventory API is integrated. Review the leaderboard and announcements; anonymous previews and aliases need developer confirmation.

sources.name: Epoch AI
sources.role: Historical notable-model inventory and date cross-check.
sources.note: Manual historical sentinel: review the official downloadable data and its source links. This selective dataset is not a census of small releases. No automatic adapter is claimed.

sources.name: Google models and research
sources.role: First-party announcements, including models not yet available.
sources.note: Review every new article for model announcements; the feed has a finite archive.

sources.name: OpenAI news
sources.note: HTTP access can be blocked. A failed fetch remains failed; use the news archive and developer changelog manually.

sources.name: Hugging Face blog
sources.role: Community and developer release leads beyond the known publisher list.
sources.note: Articles include non-release content; verify publisher identity and original model sources.

sources.name: NVIDIA deep learning
sources.note: The category feed is selective; also review model cards and research pages.
